description: Defines selectable main-menu themes: their label, BGM, thumbnail assets, per-screen background movies, and the save-data progress flags that unlock them.

Id.technical: FName row key. FindThemeRow uses StudioName_17D8 or the saved StudioMainMenuThemeIndex_38E to select an ID, scans MainMenuThemeDataTables for the row, validates its unlock state, and falls back to the first row in the first non-empty table. On selection, OnMainMenuThemeSelected stores the row's index in the collected row list (0xFF for NAME_None) into the save header. The theme list widget compares IDs to avoid rebuilding an unchanged list.

Id_Text.simple: Localized label shown for the theme.
Id_Text.technical: FName passed to MainMenuThemeText->SetTextIdOnly when a theme-list item receives focus. The row-less 'random' entry instead uses SYS_COMMON_LABEL_0042.

Id_Bgm.simple: BGM cue ID for the theme.
Id_Bgm.technical: FName passed to PlayBgm during main-menu phase preparation and again whenever a new theme is selected. The fade-in time comes from MainMenuTop_BgmFadeTime, not from the row.

ThumbnailTextureName.technical: FName used by the theme list entry when the viewport width is at or above HighResolutionThreshold; the texture is resolved with FindDynamicLoadTexture. Main-menu phase startup also prefetches it (and SmallThumbnailTextureName) through GamePrimaryAssetType_WidgetTexture for every theme row.

SmallThumbnailTextureName.technical: FName selected by the theme list entry below HighResolutionThreshold; otherwise the large texture is used. It is also included in the startup WidgetTexture prefetch list.

VsPlayerMovieFileName.simple: Background movie base name for the Vs Player screen.
VsPlayerMovieFileName.technical: FString selected by GetCursorMovieFileName for EGameMainMenuType::VsPlayer; the main menu appends '.usm' and loads it through the movie widget. The theme list item's focused preview also plays this field with '.usm' appended, regardless of the currently highlighted menu.

VsEnemyMovieFileName.simple: Background movie base name for the Vs Enemy screen.
VsEnemyMovieFileName.technical: FString selected by GetCursorMovieFileName for EGameMainMenuType::VsEnemy; '.usm' is appended before SetMovieFile.

LobbyMovieFileName.simple: Background movie base name for the Lobby screen.
LobbyMovieFileName.technical: FString selected by GetCursorMovieFileName for EGameMainMenuType::Lobby; '.usm' is appended before SetMovieFile.

StoryMovieFileName.simple: Background movie base name for the Story screen.
StoryMovieFileName.technical: FString selected by GetCursorMovieFileName for EGameMainMenuType::Story; '.usm' is appended before SetMovieFile.

ArcadeMovieFileName.simple: Background movie base name for the Arcade screen.
ArcadeMovieFileName.technical: FString selected by GetCursorMovieFileName for EGameMainMenuType::Arcade; '.usm' is appended before SetMovieFile.

FreeBattleMovieFileName.simple: Background movie base name for the Free Battle screen.
FreeBattleMovieFileName.technical: FString selected by GetCursorMovieFileName for EGameMainMenuType::FreeBattle; '.usm' is appended before SetMovieFile.

ShopMovieFileName.simple: Background movie base name for the Shop screen.
ShopMovieFileName.technical: FString selected by GetCursorMovieFileName for EGameMainMenuType::Shop; '.usm' is appended before SetMovieFile.

CollectionMovieFileName.simple: Background movie base name for the Collection/Gallery screen.
CollectionMovieFileName.technical: FString selected by GetCursorMovieFileName for EGameMainMenuType::Collection; '.usm' is appended before SetMovieFile.

UserProgressFlag.simple: List of save-data progress bits that unlock the theme.
UserProgressFlag.technical: TArray<int32>, with -1 meaning no gate. GameMainMenuWidget_IsThemeUnlocked keeps all non -1 flags and treats a theme as unlocked when the list is empty or any flag's bit is set in GameManager::UserInfo.UserProgressFlagWords (word = Flag >> 2, bit = Flag & 3, words >=128 rejected). It controls theme-list visibility, HasSelectableThemes (needs at least two unlocked rows), and the random-theme pool. Exported themes use [-1,-1], [6,-1], and [7,-1].

notes: The export contains three themes (MAIN_MENU_THEME_01..03): a default theme and two DLC variants with parallel movie names ending _DLC01/_DLC02. Only this snapshot is available; no other localization or platform variant is assumed.

Multiple MainMenuThemeDataTable shards are supported. GetFirstMainMenuThemeRow uses the first row of the first non-empty table as a fallback; FindThemeRow and the random picker prefer a matching/unlocked row.
Movie names are stored without the '.usm' extension; every movie consumer appends it. Empty names skip movie loading in the main menu's UpdateMainMenuLoad.
The theme-list item shows a fixed random-theme entry with no row when ThemeId is None; that entry uses separate hard-coded thumbnails and the generic label.

usages.detail: Returns the first theme row from the first non-empty table as the fallback.
Picks a random unlocked theme row name for the row-less/random theme entry.
Resolves the saved or default theme ID, checks unlock state, plays BGM, and prefetches all theme/banner textures.
Rebuilds the selectable theme list from unlocked rows.
Shows the focused theme's localized label.
Selects the appropriate background movie base name for the current menu.
Loads '<movie name>.usm' through the background movie widget.
